:::{#thm-marginal-mean-nonindep-interaction}

#### Marginal mean under an identity link with an interaction

Suppose
$\pi(x,c) = \eta_0 + \b_Xx + \b_Cc +\b_{XC}xc$
and $\Ef{C|X=x} = \gamma_0 + \gamma_x x$.
Then:

$$
\Ef{Y|X=x} =
(\eta_0 + \b_C\gamma_0)
+ (\b_X + \b_C\gamma_x + \b_{XC}\gamma_0) x
+ \b_{XC}\gamma_x x^2
$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-marginal-model-non-indep-interaction.

:::
